mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO SYS_NOTIFICATION_READ ( READ_ID, NOTIFICATION_ID, USER_ID, READ_STATUS, READ_TIME, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_TIME ) VALUES ( #{readId}, #{notificationId}, #{userId}, 'READ',
NOW() SYSDATE ,
NOW() SYSDATE ,
NOW() SYSDATE
) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE READ_STATUS = 'READ', READ_TIME = NOW() SYSDATE , UPDATE_TIME = NOW() SYSDATE

INSERT INTO SYS_NOTIFICATION_READ ( READ_ID, NOTIFICATION_ID, USER_ID, READ_STATUS, READ_TIME, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_TIME ) VALUES
( CONCAT(#{userId}, '_', #{notificationId}), #{notificationId}, #{userId}, 'READ',
NOW() SYSDATE ,
NOW() SYSDATE ,
NOW() SYSDATE
)
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE READ_STATUS = 'READ', READ_TIME = NOW() SYSDATE , UPDATE_TIME = NOW() SYSDATE

UPDATE SYS_NOTIFICATION_READ SET READ_STATUS = #{readStatus},
READ_TIME = NOW() SYSDATE ,
STAR_TIME = NOW() SYSDATE ,
ARCHIVE_TIME = NOW() SYSDATE ,
DELETE_TIME = NOW() SYSDATE ,
UPDATE_TIME = NOW() SYSDATE
WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND NOTIFICATION_ID IN
#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SYS_NOTIFICATION n LEFT JOIN SYS_NOTIFICATION_READ r ON n.NOTIFICATION_ID = r.NOTIFICATION_ID AND r.USER_ID = #{userId} WHERE n.NOTIFICATION_STATUS = 'PUBLISHED' AND (n.EXPIRE_TIME IS NULL OR n.EXPIRE_TIME > NOW() SYSDATE ) AND ( n.PUBLISH_SCOPE = 'ALL' OR (n.PUBLISH_SCOPE = 'USERS' AND FIND_IN_SET(#{userId}, n.TARGET_USERS)) ) AND (r.READ_STATUS IS NULL OR r.READ_STATUS = 'UNREAD')

SELECT n.NOTIFICATION_ID as notificationId, n.NOTIFICATION_TITLE as notificationTitle, n.NOTIFICATION_TYPE as notificationType, n.NOTIFICATION_LEVEL as notificationLevel, n.PUBLISH_TIME as publishTime, r.STAR_TIME as starTime FROM SYS_NOTIFICATION n INNER JOIN SYS_NOTIFICATION_READ r ON n.NOTIFICATION_ID = r.NOTIFICATION_ID WHERE r.USER_ID = #{userId} AND r.READ_STATUS = 'starred' ORDER BY r.STAR_TIME DESC

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.NOTIFICATION_ID) as readNotificationCount, COUNT(DISTINCT r.USER_ID) as readUserCount, COUNT(*) as totalReadCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN r.READ_STATUS = 'starred' THEN 1 END) as starredCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN r.READ_STATUS = 'archived' THEN 1 END) as archivedCount FROM SYS_NOTIFICATION_READ r WHERE r.READ_STATUS IN ('read', 'starred', 'archived') AND
DATE(r.READ_TIME) >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY)
TRUNC(r.READ_TIME) >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) - 30

SELECT
DATE(READ_TIME) as readDate,
TO_CHAR(read_TIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as readDate,
COUNT(*) as readCount, COUNT(DISTINCT USER_ID) as userCount, COUNT(DISTINCT NOTIFICATION_ID) as notificationCount FROM SYS_NOTIFICATION_READ WHERE READ_STATUS IN ('read', 'starred', 'archived')
AND DATE(read_TIME) >= #{startDate}
AND TRUNC(read_TIME) >= TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND DATE(read_TIME) <= #{endDate}
AND TRUNC(read_TIME) <= TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
GROUP BY DATE(read_TIME) ORDER BY DATE(read_TIME) ASC
GROUP BY TO_CHAR(read_TIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD') ORDER BY TO_CHAR(read_TIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD') ASC

SELECT USER_ID as userId, COUNT(*) as readCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN READ_STATUS = 'starred' THEN 1 END) as starredCount, MAX(READ_TIME) as lastReadTime FROM SYS_NOTIFICATION_READ WHERE READ_STATUS IN ('read', 'starred', 'archived') AND
DATE(read_TIME) >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY)
TRUNC(read_TIME) >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) - 30
GROUP BY USER_ID ORDER BY readCount DESC
LIMIT 20
AND ROWNUM <= 20
mapper.delete:
DELETE FROM SYS_NOTIFICATION_READ WHERE
CREATE_TIME < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY)
CREATE_TIME < SYSDATE - #{days}
AND READ_STATUS = 'deleted'
